_comment: When people are willing to take a meeting. Google exposes no working-hours setting through any API (Calendar's Settings has no such key), so /meet reads them from here. Times are 24-hour and local to the person's time zone; `days` are 1=Monday … 7=Sunday. The zone is the person's own calendar time zone when Oracle can read it (anyone signed in to the Hub); `timeZone` here is only the fallback for someone it can't read. `place` is the name the card shows next to their times ("6:00pm Barcelona"); without it the zone's city is shown. `people` is keyed by Google Workspace email and overrides `default` for that person only — a partial entry keeps the rest of the default. Loader: src/cards/meet-slots.js
